prompts.footman:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet for a dark medieval isometric strategy raid. Input image: visual reference for the exact footman costume, material rendering, face and color; do not modify the source file.
Create a NEW transparent RGBA sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells, six full-body poses read left to right top to bottom. No grid lines, borders, labels or text. Every cell contains only the SAME red-tabard footman with steel helmet, chainmail, red lion shield and longsword, painted realistic game art matching the reference. Turn him to face screen RIGHT in three-quarter isometric view. Six successive keyframes of a powerful sword attack: 0 preparing and lifting sword, 1 sword raised back over shoulder windup, 2 fast forward sword slash with small pale blade trail, 3 sword extended forward at impact, 4 recovering sword and balance, 5 return to guarded ready stance. The shield stays on his other arm. Keep body identity, equipment, body height, lighting and camera EXACTLY consistent, no copies of another person. Feet anchor exactly at x=50%, y=88% within EVERY cell, head around y=20%; body height about 68% of the cell, sword and shield stay within the cell with clear gutters. No movement of the root between cells; pose changes only. All equipment fully visible. Real alpha transparency, no background, ground plane, drop shadow or opaque checkerboard.
prompts.knight: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet for a dark medieval isometric strategy raid. Input image: visual reference for exact knight armor, red cloak, red lion shield and sword, realistic rendering. Create a NEW transparent RGBA sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells, six full-body poses row-major. No grid lines, labels or text. SAME heavily armored knight as reference, polished dark steel plate, closed helmet, burgundy cloak, red lion shield, broad longsword. Face screen RIGHT at a three-quarter isometric angle. Six sequential frames: 0 braced sword lift, 1 heavy overhead sword windup, 2 sweeping diagonal sword slash with subtle silver blade trail, 3 blade thrust forward in follow-through, 4 pulling blade back, 5 shield-up ready stance. Preserve exact identity, helmet, armor, shield, sword, camera and size in every cell. Feet fixed at x=50%, y=88% in each cell; helmet around y=20%, body height 68% cell. Root never translates. Every sword pose and cloak fits fully inside its own cell with gutters. Transparent background with real alpha, no ground plane, no shadow, no opaque checkerboard.
prompts.archer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production six-frame game animation atlas for a dark medieval isometric strategy raid. Input image: exact character/style reference, hooded auburn-haired female archer in olive cloak and brown leather, wooden bow, quiver. NEW transparent RGBA image landscape 1536x1024 with EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells. Six full-body sequential keyframes row-major. No grid, borders, lettering or labels. Same archer facing screen RIGHT in every frame, fixed isometric three-quarter view. Frames: 0 nocking arrow, 1 bow raised arrow pulled halfway, 2 fully drawn bow with taut string and arrow aimed right, 3 release string and arrow just leaving bow (arrow contained inside cell), 4 lowering bow after release, 5 returning ready for next shot. Consistent character identity/clothing/bow, anatomical hands, no extra arms. Feet fixed at x=50%, y=88% of EVERY cell, head at y=20%, body height 68% cell; root motion zero. Bow and arrows never extend outside each cell; clear transparent margins. Real alpha, no ground shadow or opaque checkerboard.
prompts.dragon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production six-frame game animation atlas for a dark medieval isometric strategy raid. Input image: exact red dragon identity/style reference, leathery burgundy wings, black spines, horned head, red scales. NEW transparent RGBA atlas, landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells. Six frames read left to right top to bottom. No grid or text. The SAME red flying dragon faces screen RIGHT at a three-quarter isometric angle. Six sequential fire-breath attack frames: 0 hovering with neck tucked, 1 inhale neck arched and wings lifted, 2 mouth opens glowing amber with small flame at mouth, 3 forceful exhale with a SHORT bright orange fire tongue pointing right, 4 exhale subsides to embers, 5 mouth closes and recovers hover. Fire tongue small only; full long flame rendered separately by game. Dragon's torso remains EXACTLY centered x=50%, y=50% each cell; same body size, anatomy, materials and camera every frame. Wing position varies smoothly but wing tips, tail, horns and flame stay fully INSIDE the cell with 7% transparent gutters. Dragon fills roughly 80% cell width. Real transparent alpha, no background, ground, shadow or checkerboard.

effects:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent combat VFX sprite sheet for a realistic painted medieval fantasy raid game.
Create a NEW RGBA sprite atlas on a fully TRANSPARENT background, square 1024x1024, EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, each cell exactly 256x256. 16 sprites total. No text, labels, borders, grid lines, black or colored background, or drawn checkerboard. All imagery must stay inside its cell with 12% clear transparent margins.
Each ROW is a separate effect, each COLUMN its next animation keyframe:
Row 1: four successive silver-white sword slash arcs with subtle gold sparks, progressing from small curved flash to long crescent sweep to wide swoosh to fading fragments. No sword or hand; just the motion effect, weighted to right half.
Row 2: four realistic long wooden arrows with steel pointed heads and small white feathers, all perfectly horizontal pointing RIGHT. Each arrow occupies x=15% to85%, y=50% within its cell, changing subtly from slight trailing blur to sharp to motion trail to faint wind streak; the wooden shaft, silver head, and fletching remain readable.
Row 3: four dragon breath flame-cones pointing RIGHT, starting narrow at x=12%, y=50%, expanding to a broad plume at x=88%: ignition, growing billowing orange-red fire, full bright amber fire jet, dying ember flame. White-yellow hot core, burnt orange edges and discrete embers. No dragon body or head.
Row 4: four magical fireballs flying RIGHT with the circular glowing yellow-orange core at x=65%, y=50% and a tapering flame tail trailing LEFT to x=12%. Develop from small bright orb to full blazing fireball to bursting fiery pulse to fading ring of cinders. Orange-red magical fire with gold sparks, not blue ice.
Style: detailed hand-painted high-quality game VFX, clear silhouette readable at 24 pixels, natural luminous colors and semi-transparent glowing edges, consistent size/center across frames, isolated sprite assets. Export actual alpha transparency; empty areas MUST have alpha zero.
